issues.desc: The story description and background use engineering-heavy language (STORY_INTAKE consumer, proof-admissibility scope) to describe the user-facing outcome. At PLAN time, adding a concrete mock transcript of the warning the operator sees (the actual CLI output when story_create is run for a bug without repro evidence) would make the user-observable value immediately tangible. Not blocking for INIT since the behavioral intent is clear.

background.md paragraph 1 references (B-0985/B-0405) as story IDs without a one-sentence explanation of what those stories established, making the background non-standalone for a new reader who does not have context on those story IDs.
